author: kycrafft
body:
I have noticed it is agonizingly hard to gain xp in some games, especially at higher levels. So I have some ideas for improvements:

Avicade:

1xp for participation (awarded at the end)
1xp for 4-6th
4xp for 3rd
6xp for 2nd
9xp for 1st

OiTC - 2xp for every 6 kills

Nexus/CTH:

10xp for being on the winning team for 3+ minutes
6xp for being on the 2nd place team for 3+ minutes
4xp for being on the 3rd place team for 3+ minutes
2xp for being on the 4th place team for 3+ minutes

5 extra xp for playing on one team for 9+ minutes

CTH only:

4xp for being on the hill

Nexus only:

1xp for buying your team something (steak does not count)

Walls:

8xp for kills
15xp for winning
6 extra xp for 5+ kills

Any other suggestions? (I don't play elim so I don't know about the xp there)
